copy.text: List each child's documents, relevant permission evidence and transport booking under their own name.
Plan food and feeding supplies around the child's established needs.
Keep required medicines, aids and current care instructions accessible.
Name the adult responsible for each shared task and essential bag.

eyebrow.text: Prepare per child, not just per suitcase
